$comment: The lists under Settings → Tracking: accounts, categories, tags, debts, recurring (settings/accounts.tsx, categories.tsx, tags.tsx, debts.tsx, recurring.tsx).

accounts.title: Accounts

introShort.message: Where money sits: cash, a card, a bank account. Balances and net worth add up from them.
introShort.note: Note above the accounts list; the ⓘ unfolds introMore.

introMore.message: Every transaction belongs to one account. A group (“Personal”, “Business”) limits the app to some of them.

accounts.emptyHint: Tap + to add one, or restore a backup in Settings.

group.note: Section header for accounts that are in no group.

current.note: Row subtitle of the account the app treats as current; type is "Card".

archivedType.note: Row subtitle of an archived account; type is "Card".

categories.title: Categories

introShort.message: What money was spent on. Budgets and every chart are built from categories.
introShort.note: Note above the categories list; the ⓘ unfolds introMore.

introMore.message: A folder groups categories and is never filed into: a transaction goes to a category inside it. New categories in a folder take its colour.

categories.mattersNone: Not set yet · two questions, five minutes

mattersPartial.note: How many categories have an importance set, and how many do not.

categories.emptyHint: Add a folder, then categories inside it.

folder.message: Folder · {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}

folderIncome.message: Folder · income · {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}
folderIncome.note: Subtitle of a folder that holds income.

categories.archivedNote: Not offered for new entries; what is filed under them still counts. Open one to restore it.

tags.title: Tags

introShort.message: A tag cuts across categories: #work lunch, #vacation fuel.
introShort.note: Note above the tags list; the ⓘ unfolds introMore.

introMore.message: A tag can be limited to the categories it makes sense in and carry a budget of its own. Travel mode tags a whole trip for you.

uses.note: How many transactions carry the tag.

usesOnly.message: {count, plural, one {# use} other {# uses}} · only for {categories}
usesOnly.note: categories is a comma-separated list of category names.

tags.usesAny: {count, plural, one {# use} other {# uses}} · any category
tags.usesArchived: {count, plural, one {# use} other {# uses}} · archived

travel.note: Section header: tags made by travel mode, one per trip.

tags.archivedNote: Not offered for new entries; past ones and budgets on them still count. Open one to restore it.

introShort.message: Money lent or borrowed. It touches no balance until it is paid.
introShort.note: Note above the debts list; the ⓘ unfolds introMore.

introMore.message: Settling a debt here writes the transaction for you. With a due date, a reminder comes the day before and on the day, at the time you choose.

recurring.title: Recurring

fallbackTitle.note: Name of a rule with no payee and no category.

noRate.message: No rate yet for {currencies} — those rules are not counted.

recurring.waitSubtitle: Let the real payment arrive and settle the rule, instead of adding one on the day

days.note: How long a rule waits for the bank's charge.

noteShort.message: Rules for money that comes back: rent, subscriptions, salary.
noteShort.note: Note under the recurring settings card; the ⓘ unfolds noteMoreWait or noteMoreNoWait.

noteMoreWait.message: On its day the rule waits: the charge your bank notifies, or one you log, settles it at the amount actually charged. If none arrives in time, automatic rules post their own amount and manual ones ask. Each rule can set its own window. Repeats spotted in your history are offered below.
noteMoreWait.note: Unfolds under noteShort while waiting for the bank is on.

noteMoreNoWait.message: Automatic rules post on the day and tell you; manual ones ask first, for payments whose day or amount varies. If the Shortcut automation already logs these, turn on waiting above to avoid duplicates. Repeats spotted in your history are offered below.
noteMoreNoWait.note: Unfolds under noteShort while waiting for the bank is off.

suggestionPlanned.note: A rule suggested from a future-dated entry (a payment logged ahead of its day). freq is "monthly", date "22 Sep".

suggestionSeen.note: A rule suggested from repeats in history; count is how many times it was seen.

expectedPosts.message: Expected {date} · posts if nothing arrives within {days}
expectedPosts.note: date is "22 Sep"; days is "3 days".

expectedAsks.message: Expected {date} · asks if nothing arrives within {days}
expectedAsks.note: date is "22 Sep"; days is "3 days".

footShort.message: Totals count active rules only, converted to a year.
footShort.note: Footnote at the bottom of the recurring list; the ⓘ unfolds footMoreWait or footMoreNoWait.

footMoreWait.message: Reminders are local notifications on this phone. A rule acts only once its window closes without a charge.
footMoreWait.note: Unfolds under footShort while waiting is on.

footMoreNoWait.message: Reminders are local notifications on this phone. Automatic rules post on the day; manual ones wait for your tap.
footMoreNoWait.note: Unfolds under footShort while waiting is off.

posting.title: How does it get paid?
posting.autoSubtitle: It leaves your account by itself — a subscription or standing order on a fixed day. Kopiyka adds it for you and tells you it did.
posting.manualSubtitle: The day or the amount moves around, so Kopiyka asks first and you post it once it has actually gone out.

source.title: Where does it come from?
source.txSubtitle: Pick one you already logged — title, amount, category, tags and how often are filled in
source.newSubtitle: Amount and name, then the rest on the rule screen

recurring.name: What is it called?

daily.note: How often a rule repeats; count is the interval.
